boards.title: Challenge sign-ups
boards.reachable: Account > Collections > AO3CollectionDetailView Manage > 'Sign-ups' (maintainer + dashboard.signUpsURL, AO3CollectionDetailView.swift:275); also 1by Assignments panel 'Sign-ups' row (ChallengeSettingsView.swift:338)

gaps.current: Rows draw a chevron and set @State selectedSignUp, but nothing reads it: no sheet, push or destination. Tapping a sign-up does nothing.
gaps.needs: Spec rows carry a disclosure chevron. Push a read-only sign-up detail, or ChallengeSignUpView(existingSignUpID:) for the moderator's read, or drop the chevron.

gaps.element: '3 requests · 5 offers' count line and one-line request tag summary
gaps.current: parseChallengeSignUpsPage builds at most one request (the li text, or all a.tag lumped into fandoms) and never any offers. Every row reads '1 requests · 0 offers' (also unpluralised), and the summary is empty or every tag mixed together.
gaps.needs: Spec: '3 requests · 5 offers' / 'Good Omens (TV), Jujutsu Kaisen, Naruto'. Parse otwarchive's challenge_signups index markup into separate requests and offers with their fandom tags (check the real template, since the fixture may be invented). Pluralise the count.

gaps.element: Matched/unmatched chip honesty on join failure
gaps.current: If challengeSignUpsJoinedToAssignments throws, it silently falls back to plain sign-ups, so every row shows UNMATCHED. The comment claims this avoids 'falsified match states' and still calls the parser a KNOWN DEFECT, which is stale after 1b37613c rebuilt it.
gaps.needs: BUILD: 'matched state comes from the assignments object… joined client-side before the list can render its chips'. On fallback, hide the chip and the Matched/Unmatched segments (or show 'match state unavailable'). Remove the stale KNOWN DEFECT note.

gaps.element: Header count '31 sign-ups · open until 1 Oct 2026'
gaps.current: Counts only the sign-ups fetched so far (page 1 = at most 20), not the challenge total
gaps.needs: Parse the total from AO3's pagination or heading, or say 'N loaded'

gaps.current: Both buttons open the identical ChallengeSignUpView sheet (new-sign-up form), and that view wraps its own NavigationStack with no close control
gaps.needs: Spec bottom bar: 'Your sign-up' + 'Create sign-up'. 'Your sign-up' should open the existing sign-up (existingSignUpID) when there is one. Add a Done/Close toolbar item in sheet mode.

boards.notes: Structure matches: kicker/title/subtitle header, All/Matched/Unmatched SubjectSegmentedControl, the 'Sign-ups' SectionRuleHeader, a subjectPanel list with SubjectRowSeparator, the matched pill styled as the spec draws it, the footnote copy verbatim, a load-more row, and the bottom bar. Loading and error states exist. The biggest real gap is the parser: request/offer counts and tag summary cannot render the spec's data.

boards.title: Your sign-up
boards.reachable: AO3CollectionDetailView Manage > 'Your Sign-up' (logged in + signUpsURL, AO3CollectionDetailView.swift:293), pushed; also as a sheet from 1bz's bottom bar

gaps.element: Per-request tag limits checked before submit
gaps.current: validated() checks only the request and offer counts. The footnote says 'X to Y requests and A to B offers per sign-up'. Fandom, relationship and character counts per request are never checked.
gaps.needs: Spec: 'The challenge asks for 3 to 5 fandoms and 1 to 3 relationships per request, from 1by. Those limits are checked here before submit'. Parse the per-field required/allowed limits into AO3ChallengeSignUpForm. AO3PromptRestrictionSnapshot already models them for settings, and the settings edit page is maintainer-only. Then validate each prompt and word the footnote per tag type.

gaps.element: Nested NavigationStack on the push route
gaps.current: The body is wrapped in its own NavigationStack but pushed via subjectRowNavigation from AO3CollectionDetailView, so one stack sits inside another. As a sheet from 1bz it has no close button.
gaps.needs: Drop the inner NavigationStack. Let the 1bz sheet wrap it in one NavigationStack and add a Done/Cancel toolbar item.

gaps.element: Withdraw after close is a different write
gaps.current: Withdraw always calls withdrawSignUp (DELETE, open sign-ups only). withdrawSignUpAfterClose / reportAssignmentDefault are built but have no caller, yet the dialog tells the user 'If sign-ups have closed, this will record a default'.
gaps.needs: BUILD: 'Withdrawing after close is a different endpoint from editing before it.' Branch on the sign-up being closed (settings.signupOpen / form state) and call withdrawSignUpAfterClose with the user's assignment id.

gaps.current: Toggle row has no caption and binds only anyRelationship
gaps.needs: Spec: 'Any of these is fine / Matches on any chosen tag rather than all of them'. Add the caption (SubjectFormRow has no subtitle; ChallengeSettingsView.typeRow:169 shows the two-line pattern).

gaps.current: ensureMinimumPrompts seeds an offer with id -2, and addNewOffer computes -(offers.count+1) = -2 for the second offer, so two offers share an id and ForEach(id: \.element.id) collides
gaps.needs: Use a monotonic negative counter or min(id)-1 for the ids of new prompts

boards.notes: Sections match the spec: header 'Your sign-up' with the live 'Request n of N · Offer n of N' subtitle; per-request SectionRuleHeader with Fandoms/Relationships/Characters/Additional tags SubjectFormRows ('n chosen'), the toggle, and the prompt card ('Visible to your recipient only', 'n / 1000'); Offers panel with 'Good Omens (TV) · 2 tags' summaries and 'Add an offer'; the offers footnote verbatim; bottom bar 'Add request' / 'Submit sign-up'. Submit and withdraw are AO3 writes (saveChallengeSignUp/withdrawSignUp): built, never live-verified. The Withdraw section is an addition the board does not draw.

boards.title: Assignments

gaps.current: Loads only list .assignments, which is ?fulfilled=true, so only delivered assignments appear. Open, undelivered assignments (.unfulfilled) are never fetched, and only page 1 of any list is read.
gaps.needs: BUILD: 'Three paged lists behind one screen.' Load .assignments + .unfulfilled for Matched, and page every list (AO3Client.allChallengeAssignments already does this crawl).

gaps.current: The default segment is .matched and the segment shows ONE section at a time. The board stacks 'Unmatched sign-ups' first, then Matched, then Pinch hits. The section is titled 'Unmatched', not 'Unmatched sign-ups'.
gaps.needs: LABEL: 'Unmatched leads, because it is the only part a moderator has to act on.' Default to .unmatched, or stack the sections in spec order under the segment. Retitle to 'Unmatched sign-ups'.

gaps.current: Claims '<a> and <b> share no fandom with any remaining offer' for rows that are really the defaults queue (defaulted, uncovered assignments). The app never computes a fandom mismatch, and the names are paired arbitrarily two per card.
gaps.needs: Spec copy assumes unmatched sign-ups from potential matching. Either parse potential_matches for truly unmatched sign-ups (M) or reword to what the defaults list proves (S).

gaps.current: Only 'Delivered' (isFulfilled) and 'Defaulted'. No 'late' (past due and not fulfilled).
gaps.needs: Spec matched rows: 'delivered', 'late'. Derive late from the due date plus !isFulfilled.

gaps.current: worksDueAt is read from settings.worksRevealAt (the reveal date), so the header 'works due …' and every row's 'due …' show the reveal date
gaps.needs: Use settings.assignmentsDueAt (AO3's assignments_due_at is when works are due; 1cf's spec lists 'Works due' separately from 'Works revealed')

gaps.current: Same 'request → giver' row as Matched, plus a Claim capsule. No 'Pinch hit #n' title, no open/claimed state pill, no 'Open · posted <date> · <fandom>' line, no 'Requested by <pseud>' / 'Claimed by <pseud> · due <date>'.
gaps.needs: Spec: 'Pinch hit #1 · open · Open · posted 4 Nov · Good Omens (TV) · Requested by tidewrack'. A dedicated pinch-hit row, and if the assignment row parse lacks posted date or fandom, extend parseAssignmentRow.

gaps.element: Bottom bar 'Report a default' / 'Claim a pinch hit'
gaps.current: No bottom bar. AO3AuthService.reportAssignmentDefault is built but has no caller anywhere. Claim is only a per-row capsule on the Pinch hits segment.
gaps.needs: BUILD: 'Reporting a default and claiming a pinch hit are writes'. Add the two-button bar, wire Report a default (pick assignment + confirmation dialog), and keep the row Claim or route the bar button to it.

gaps.current: '…it cannot re-run matching or file a pinch hit request', shown only on the Unmatched segment when non-empty
gaps.needs: Spec: 'Assignments and pinch hits are paged lists. The app can read them, report a default and send a pinch-hit request; it cannot run AO3's matching, so no screen here offers to.'

gaps.current: Each list fetch is try?, so a network or parse failure renders 'Every sign-up matched.' / 'No matched assignments yet.'. The comment still cites a stale 'KNOWN DEFECT'.
gaps.needs: Surface a per-list error card instead of an empty-state claim

boards.notes: Present: header 'Assignments' with 'n matched · n unmatched · works due' (date wrong), the Matched/Unmatched/Pinch hits segment, unmatched cards with 'Send pinch-hit request' + 'Open on AO3' (both honest Open-on-AO3 links, documented at file top), and a per-row Claim pinch hit (AO3 write via claimPinchHit, never live-verified). Matching is correctly not offered.

gaps.current: Counts the prompts on the current page only

boards.notes: Present: sections Basics/Schedule/Sign-up limits/(Tag set)/Matching/Anonymity and moderation/At AO3 in spec order; the schedule footnote ('AO3 stores every date in UTC…') and matching footnote verbatim; local validation before post; field errors inline; 'Run matching' and 'Delete challenge' as Opens AO3 rows; 'Save changes' bottom bar. The save is an AO3 write (updateChallengeSettings, :659): built, never live-verified. UTC round-trip is at the model layer. The header comment's omissions are the implementer's own rationale, not owner decisions, so they are reported as gaps.

areaNotes: All six boards are built and reachable from Account > Collections > AO3CollectionDetailView's Manage section; none is DONE. The plan doc (REDESIGN_PLAN.md:289 'All 11 screens built… All reachable' and the 2026-09-15 audit at :1170 'nothing to build') overstates the state. Cross-cutting: (1) stale 'KNOWN DEFECT' comments in ChallengeSignUpsView:410, ChallengeSettingsView:495 and ChallengeAssignmentsView:440 still describe the pre-1b37613c assignment parser, and their try?/fallback paths turn fetch failures into false empty or unmatched states; (2) reportAssignmentDefault and withdrawSignUpAfterClose (AO3ChallengeActions.swift:94,100) are built with zero UI callers; (3) 'works due' is sourced from worksRevealAt in both 1by and 1cb; (4) potential_match_settings is never parsed, which blocks 1cf's Matching rows and 1by's fandom-match toggle; (5) 1by is routed only to non-maintainers but reads maintainer-only AO3 pages. Unverified offline: otwarchive access rules and the sign-up index markup. No builds and no network used.
